public_authorities_and_labs.name: Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA / LIRR)
public_authorities_and_labs.it_structure: Direct hire (exempt from standard DCAS civil service examinations). Offers software engineering, data systems, transit telematics, and cybersecurity roles across MTA IT, Long Island Rail Road (LIRR), Metro-North, and NYC Transit.
public_authorities_and_labs.headquarters: 2 Broadway, New York, NY 10004 & Jamaica Station, Queens (LIRR HQ)

public_authorities_and_labs.name: Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL)
public_authorities_and_labs.type: U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) National Laboratory / Brookhaven Science Associates
public_authorities_and_labs.location: Upton, NY (Town of Brookhaven, Long Island)
public_authorities_and_labs.it_structure: Non-profit research laboratory operated under DOE prime contract. Hires scientific programmers, cloud software engineers, HPC specialists, Python/C++ developers, and data pipeline engineers. Not subject to NY state civil service exams; standard technical interviews and direct application.
public_authorities_and_labs.usajobs_crosslist: Select senior roles and fellowships cross-post to USAJOBS Series 1550/2210.

public_authorities_and_labs.name: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey (PANYNJ)
public_authorities_and_labs.it_structure: Bi-state entity exempt from NY and NJ civil service laws. Direct application with competitive technical interviews. Operates JFK, LaGuardia, Newark, Port Authority Bus Terminal, PATH, and Hudson River crossings.
public_authorities_and_labs.headquarters: 4 World Trade Center, 150 Greenwich Street, New York, NY 10007

public_authorities_and_labs.name: Long Island Power Authority (LIPA) / PSEG Long Island
public_authorities_and_labs.it_structure: LIPA is a state public authority; electric grid operations are contracted to PSEG Long Island. Hires smart-grid software engineers, GIS analysts, SCADA engineers, and data analysts.

public_authorities_and_labs.name: Suffolk County Water Authority (SCWA)
public_authorities_and_labs.it_structure: Operates under Suffolk County Civil Service Commission guidelines with competitive, non-competitive, and labor class positions for IT infrastructure, GIS, water modeling, and enterprise ERP systems.

public_authorities_and_labs.name: New York Power Authority (NYPA)
public_authorities_and_labs.it_structure: Direct-hire authority positions covering grid software, telemetry, renewable energy analytics, and cybersecurity.
public_authorities_and_labs.headquarters: 123 Main Street, White Plains, NY 10601 with Long Island transmission facilities
